lanes.title: Estonian terminology compression
lanes.focus: Replace mixed English/Estonian technical prose with idiomatic Estonian, remove unnecessary English glosses, and keep established acronyms consistent.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one Englishism, unnecessary "ingl ..." gloss, or inconsistent term that can be replaced with a shorter Estonian form.
lanes.writer_extra: Replace the term or sentence with idiomatic Estonian. Preserve code/model names. Prefer net-shorter wording.

lanes.title: Redundancy pruning
lanes.focus: Remove repeated claims, duplicated caveats, and over-explained transitions inside one chapter while preserving the argument.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify the single clearest repetition or overlong transition in the target chapter.
lanes.writer_extra: Delete, merge, or shorten that passage. Do not add new signposting unless it replaces a longer unclear sentence.

lanes.title: Committee-facing compression
lanes.focus: Pre-empt likely defense questions by sharpening existing explanations, not by adding new caveat lists.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Pose one committee-style concern and identify the existing sentence/paragraph that can answer it more tightly.
lanes.writer_extra: Tighten the existing passage so it is more defensible and shorter or same length. Do not add new claims.

lanes.title: Claim–evidence calibration
lanes.focus: Make existing claims match existing evidence; prefer softening or shortening unsupported claims over adding more prose.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Find one claim whose evidence is vague, repeated, or stronger than the cited/table-backed result.
lanes.writer_extra: Attach existing evidence only if needed; otherwise shorten or soften the claim. No fabricated numbers and no new side discussion.

lanes.title: Literature gap compression
lanes.focus: Keep prior-art positioning concise, citation-backed, and free of source footnotes or duplicated comparisons.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one prior-art or literature-gap passage that can be shortened, deduplicated, or moved from footnote-style prose into normal citation style.
lanes.writer_extra: Tighten existing positioning using citations already present. Do not add new sources, new subsections, or long comparison paragraphs.

lanes.title: Citation and formal hygiene
lanes.focus: TalTech/Estonian thesis style: bibliography citations instead of source footnotes, clean captions, quotes, dashes, units, and cross-references.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one concrete formal issue: source footnote, overlong caption, straight quotes, broken reference, unit spacing, or mixed citation style.
lanes.writer_extra: Fix only that one issue. Prefer shortening captions/notes and converting source footnotes to bibliography citations when safe.

lanes.title: Summary compression
lanes.focus: Keep summary crisp, self-contained, and no longer than necessary; remove repeated setup already covered in the introduction.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Find the single summary sentence that can be shortened, made more accurate, or deduplicated from earlier chapters.
lanes.writer_extra: Rewrite that one sentence only; net-shorter unless correcting a factual ambiguity.

lanes.title: Methodology compression
lanes.focus: Compress reproducibility prose: keep details needed to interpret results, remove low-level configuration logs from the main narrative.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one methodology detail block that is too log-like or too low-level for the main text.
lanes.writer_extra: Replace that detail block with a shorter thesis-level description. Do not add new parameters.

lanes.title: Introduction compressor
lanes.focus: Tighten the introduction: problem, scope, research question, contribution, and limits in fewer words and cleaner Estonian.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one introduction sentence or paragraph that is redundant, overlong, or mixed-language.
lanes.writer_extra: Shorten or rewrite at most one paragraph. Do not add new motivation or literature unless replacing longer existing text.

lanes.title: Implementation detail compressor
lanes.focus: Compress Android/ESP32/ESPHome implementation prose; keep thesis-relevant facts and remove repo-log-level detail.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one implementation passage that reads like a repository log or configuration dump rather than thesis prose.
lanes.writer_extra: Shorten the passage to the design-relevant point. Do not add implementation details.

lanes.title: Evaluation compression and closeout
lanes.focus: Compress evaluation history and keep benchmark, field, and user-test evidence clearly separated; add only final user-test results when present.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one result-history passage, limitation, or bridge that can be shortened or deduplicated without losing evidence.
lanes.writer_extra: Tighten at most one short result/limitation passage. Add prose only for final user-test data already present in tracked outputs.

lanes.title: Alternatives comparison compression
lanes.focus: Keep comparison against alternatives concise and non-duplicative; remove repeated or overly broad framing.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one comparison point that is duplicated, too broad, or longer than needed for an already-cited alternative.
lanes.writer_extra: Shorten or merge the comparison sentence/paragraph using existing citations only. Do not introduce new alternatives.

lanes.title: Research note (paused in compression mode)
lanes.focus: Paused during compression-first closeout; reactivate only when a mandatory missing source/evidence gap is approved.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Paused: push back unless the user explicitly asks to collect a missing source.
lanes.writer_extra: Paused: do not append research notes during compression mode.

lanes.title: Distill sentence (paused in compression mode)
lanes.focus: Paused during compression-first closeout; reactivate only to insert approved mandatory evidence.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Paused: push back unless the latest approved research note maps to a mandatory thesis gap.
lanes.writer_extra: Paused: do not add thesis prose during compression mode.
